raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (txn_date 2026-01-16) was delivered with amount in cents: amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' on 345 rows, while currency still says USD. silver_transactions ignores amount_unit, so those amounts are 100x too large.
